    FAQ

    • How many users do I need?

      Every person added to your PagerDuty account is a paid user, including those who are receiving notifications or are included in a schedule.

    • How does the 14-day trial work?

      Our trial is a full-featured free trial for 14 days that you can start using instantly. No credit card required so you won’t be charged until you are ready to buy. When you are ready, select any of the available plans to continue using PagerDuty.

    • What are my payment options?

      We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, and JCB through your online account. Want to pay via invoice? Sure! We’ll gladly set up an annual invoice. Just call or contact us.

    • How many systems can I monitor?

      You can monitor as many or as few systems as you want with PagerDuty. Whether you want to monitor one computer with Nagios or use Datadog, Icinga and Zenoss to monitor hundreds of applications across thousands of hosts, we won't charge you extra. We have 750+ pre-built integrations so you can connect PagerDuty to your monitoring tools of choice.

    • How many notifications are included in my account?

      Notifications can be sent by email, push, SMS, and phone. All customers get unlimited email and push notifications. Professional, Business, and Digital Operations plans also get unlimited global SMS and phone notifications. Free customers receive 100 SMS and phone notifications.

    • Can I only purchase AIOps?

      You will have to purchase at least one user on a Professional or Business Incident Response plan to be able to purchase AIOps.

    • Are there any lower cost options for users who are not responders?

      You can purchase lower cost user licenses for business stakeholders who get read-only access to your PagerDuty products. If you purchase the Business plan or Digital Operations plan, stakeholder users can subscribe to incidents for real-time updates during critical outages to improve organization-wide response.

    • How is PagerDuty AIOps priced?

      PagerDuty is committed to providing customers with the best value and ROI. With that in mind, PagerDuty AIOps is licensed per accepted event. Accepted events are any valid events that are sent to and processed by PagerDuty via email integration or API with a successful 2xx response. The number of events should correlate with the number of 2xx responses a customer receives back from the events API. For more details, go here.

    • What's not included in Digital Operations Management?

      Global Event Orchastration is not included. See PagerDuty AIOps.

    Noise Reduction
    Alert Field Enrichment and Extraction

    Alert Suppression
    Suppress certain types of alerts to ensure that actionable, high-priority alerts receive the greatest attention.
    Alert Thresholds
    Receive PagerDuty notifications only when your customized alert conditions breach user-specified limits.
    Alert Grouping
    Automatically group alerts based on timing, content, or intelligent models to streamline incident response and reduce noise.
    Time-Based Alert Grouping
    Group alerts together that arrive within a specified time window.
    Intelligent Alert Grouping
    Employ a machine-learning-based model uniquely trained on the history of each service’s alerts to group them together based on a customizable time window, keeping your team focused on the problem at hand.
    Content-Based Alert Grouping
    Group alerts together based on their content, with complete customizability. Use it together with dynamic field extraction and enrichment.
    Intelligent and Content-Based Alert Grouping
    Combine machine learning and customizable content-based rules to group related alerts.
    Global Alert Grouping
    Group alerts across multiple technical services (supports all alert grouping types, except time-based grouping).
    Paused Incident Notifications
    Reduce unnecessary transient noise from flapping alerts by delaying notifications, giving machines a chance to auto-remediate before notifying responders.
    Auto-Paused Incident Notifications
    Provide the option to elect for PagerDuty machine learning to detect and silence these self-healing alerts to avoid disturbing responders.
    Noise Reduction Home Page
    Provides a high-level overview of Alert Grouping and Auto-Pause Incident Notification settings with streamlined editing.
    Root Cause Analysis
    Past Incidents
    Shorten resolution times by viewing past incidents, understanding when these types of incidents happen, and diving into any of these incidents to discover what remediation steps were taken in the past.
    Related Incidents
    Use machine learning to view related incidents across other services and teams to better understand the breadth and scope of incident impact.
    Outlier Incidents
    Use historical incident data to identify incident types that are anomalous occurrences that might be harder to resolve or frequent alerts that could be automatically remediated or targets for performance improvements.
    Probable Origin
    Provide an auto-generated list of likely origin points using historical data of correlated incident patterns, surfacing where (and where not) to look first when troubleshooting major incidents.
    Change Correlation
    Provide contextual information on the change event for a given incident (for ex. correlation of a change to an incident based on ML, related service, or time.
    Change Events
    Integrates change events from the software delivery process (CI/CD pipelines) and code repositories, enabling visibility across changes to better understand their impact.
    Custom Change Event Transformer
    Allow users to ingest change events from across their digital ecosystem, enabling visibility across changes to better understand their impact.
    Orchestration
    Advanced Event Orchestration
    Cut down on manual event processing with a powerful decision engine where teams can create custom logic to enrich, modify, and control routing based on event conditions at scale. Includes rule nesting, schedule conditions, threshold conditions, and webhooks.
    Variable Extraction & Enrichment
    Dynamically extract data from events at ingest and capture it in user-defined custom fields on the incident as well as in detailed automations.
    Dynamic Service Routes, Escalation Policies, and Cache Variables
    Store event data or external data for use after an event has been processed to allow future events to gain information associated with past events for more dynamic, customizable automations.
    Global Event Orchestration
    Enrich events, control their routing, and trigger self-healing actions based on event data. Teams can use this functionality across any or all services within PagerDuty.
    Visibility
    Operations Console
    Take action on time-critical incidents from a sharable, centralized command center. Access key contextual information at a glance, take actions on alerts, enrich workflows with Custom Fields, and utilize advanced filtering.

    Runbook Automation for Incident Management

    Feature list

    Runbook Automation
    Get Started
    Fully-Managed SaaS
    Core Features
    Workflow Execution
    Enables the orchestration and automation of complex sequences of tasks, allowing users to define and execute workflows that encompass multiple steps, dependencies, and conditions, simplifying the management and coordination of diverse operations.
    Community Plugins
    Standardization of IT Workflow execution (Provisioning, Security, Software Updates / Deployment, Change Configs, Opening Ports, and more)
    A Job is a unit that encapsulates a series of ordered steps to solve a problem or perform a task which makes your life a little easier.
    Key and Password Encryption
    Provides the secure storage and management of sensitive information such as passwords, API keys, and authentication tokens, protecting them from unauthorized access by encrypting them at rest and providing secure access controls for retrieval and usage.
    Basic Ops Scheduling for Tasks
    Enables users to schedule the execution of specific tasks or jobs at predefined intervals or timeframes, allowing for automated and regular execution of routine operations, maintenance tasks, and other operational processes, simplifying scheduling and reducing manual effort.
    Job Activity Log
    Provides a comprehensive record of job executions, capturing detailed information such as start times, durations, status updates, and output logs, allowing users to monitor and review the activity of their jobs for troubleshooting, auditing, and performance analysis purposes.
    Key Storage
    A mechanism for Rundeck Admins to implement or utilize existing storage of sensitive private key/password data ("keys") that can be used to configure plugins, node executors, and other aspects of the automation environment.
    Support
    Enterprise Support (Priority-Based Support, Account Management, SLA Response, and more)
    Dedicated technical assistance, priority access to updates and bug fixes, and additional resources to ensure smooth operation and timely resolution of issues for organizations utilizing Rundeck at an enterprise scale, providing enhanced reliability, support, and peace of mind.
    Resiliency
    High Availability Clusters, ensures Runbook Automation is continuously operational
    Enables the deployment of multiple Rundeck instances in a clustered setup, ensuring continuous availability and fault tolerance by distributing the workload and providing seamless failover capabilities, increasing system reliability and reducing downtime for critical operations.
    PagerDuty managed high availability and reliability with SLA (99.9%)
    Failed Job Resume
    Allows users to easily resume the execution of failed or incomplete jobs from the point of failure, eliminating the need to restart the entire job and saving time and effort by automatically resuming from the last successful step or known checkpoint.
    Node Health Checks
    Allows users to perform automated health checks on nodes within a cluster or network, verifying their availability, connectivity, and readiness for job execution, ensuring the reliability and optimal performance of the infrastructure by identifying and addressing potential issues.
    Auto Takeover
    Enables automatic failover in high availability clusters, allowing a standby instance to take over the responsibilities of the primary instance in case of failure, ensuring continuous operation and minimizing downtime without requiring manual intervention.
    Retry Failed Nodes
    Allows for automatic retry of failed job executions on specific nodes, providing an automated mechanism to handle transient failures or intermittent connectivity issues, ensuring the completion of tasks even in the presence of temporary node failures.
    Security
    Single Sign-On Authentication
    Allows users to authenticate and access the platform using their existing enterprise identity provider, such as LDAP, Active Directory, or SAML, streamlining the login process, enhancing security, and providing a seamless user experience across multiple systems and applications.
    PagerDuty handles security patching, protection, monitoring, and compliance.
    Deeper Solutions Integrations
    Certified Enterprise Plugins
    (ServiceNow, Kubernetes, Ansible, Datadog, VMWare, Github, AWS SNS, SQL Runner, and many more)
    Advanced Webhooks
    GitHub, AWS SNS, PagerDuty, etc. Includes Rule Based Processing and in-product Debugging
    Scalability
    Load Balanced Workloads
    Distributing job execution across multiple nodes or clusters to optimize resource utilization and performance. Horizontally scale your cluster by designating specific cluster members to handle certain types of traffic. This allows for efficient handling of workloads by automatically distributing tasks among available nodes.
    Job Queuing, job executions can be queued when parallel executions are not allowed
    Job Queuing, job executions can be queued when parallel executions are not allowed

    Workflow Visualization
    Provides a graphical representation of workflows, allowing users to visually understand the sequence of steps, dependencies, and conditions in their automation processes. This feature aids in troubleshooting, identifying bottlenecks, and gaining a comprehensive overview of the workflow execution flow.
    Ruleset Workflow Strategy Plugin
    Provides more complex logic around job step execution
    GUI based ACL via Access Control Rules Builder and Evaluator
    Configuration Management
    Facilitates the management and synchronization of configuration files and settings across multiple servers or nodes, allowing users to automate the deployment and configuration of software and infrastructure components, ensuring consistency and reducing manual effort in maintaining configurations across the system.
    Scheduling
    Job Independent Scheduling
    Define schedules for specific jobs or workflows, specifying when they should be executed based on time, intervals, or other criteria. Each job operates independently and can have its own unique schedule.
    Blackout Calendaring
    Allows users to define specific time periods during which job executions should be disabled or paused, providing a mechanism to schedule maintenance windows, avoid disruptions during critical periods, or prevent unwanted job execution during specified timeframes. It enables better control over when jobs can run and helps avoid conflicts with planned activities or system downtimes.

    PagerDuty Advance
    Learn More
    Generative AI
    PagerDuty Advance Assistant for Slack and Microsoft Teams
    A genAI chatbot that provides responder teams with helpful insight before, during, and after incidents. Users can ask simple questions to surface key context and summaries of incidents, or information about PagerDuty setup and configuration—without context switching.
    PagerDuty Advance for Automation Actions
    Part of the Actions Log, this feature summarizes the most important results from running automation jobs in one place. Responders can make informed decisions based on diagnostic results and even load the output as key values into variables in Event Orchestration for dynamic automation.
    PagerDuty Advance Analytics
    Get a before and after view of the operational efficiencies gained and time saved from implementation of PagerDuty Advance.
    Agentic AI
    SRE Agent
    Accelerates triage through remediation. Gathers signals and data across the tech stack, analyzes error logs, runs diagnostics, and compares similar incidents to recommended remediation steps—and executes them with human approval. It learns from every response to generate smart runbooks and prevent recurring issues. Available within the Operations Console, and for Slack and Microsoft Teams users.
    Scribe Agent
    Automatically transcribes incident meetings and combines it with chat history, capturing critical details and keeping teams in sync with context-aware incident summaries and status updates drafts. Available for Slack + Zoom / Google Meet AND Microsoft Teams users.
    Shift Agent
    Automatically detect conflicts between planned time-off and upcoming on-call shifts, find available replacements, request and manage overrides, resulting in lower operational costs and positive customer impact. Available in Slack.
    Insights Agent
    Delivers proactive recommendations and on-demand insights to improve operations over time, based on PagerDuty analytics data. Available for Slack and Microsoft Teams.
